summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Stock Management and Invoices/Cobrança features. Backend: 147/147 tests passed (100%) including 36 new stock/invoices tests. Frontend: All features working correctly - Materials stock columns/badges/movement dialogs, Faturas page with KPIs/filters/table/payment dialog/WhatsApp button, Orçamentos stock badge integration.
seed_data_creation: Test materials, invoices, and budgets created during testing with TEST_ prefix were cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stock Management and Invoices/Cobrança features fully tested and working. Key verified flows: (1) POST /api/materials with stock_current/stock_min persists values, (2) POST /api/stock/movement creates entrada/saida movements, updates material stock, rejects insufficient stock with 400, (3) GET /api/stock/movements supports ?material_id filter, (4) GET /api/stock/low returns materials where stock_current <= stock_min (only where stock_min > 0), (5) POST /api/invoices creates with auto-number FT YYYY/NNNN, computes status/balance/days_overdue, (6) GET /api/invoices supports status/year/month filters, (7) POST /api/invoices/{id}/payment adds payment, recomputes status (pendente->parcial->paga, vencida->vencida_parcial->paga), (8) DELETE /api/invoices/{id}/payment/{payment_id} removes payment, (9) POST /api/invoices/{id}/reminder-log logs WhatsApp reminder, (10) GET /api/invoices/summary returns aggregations, (11) Frontend MateriaisPage shows Stock column with green/red badges, entry/exit arrow buttons open stock movement dialog, form has stock_current/stock_min inputs, (12) Frontend FaturasPage shows 4 KPI cards, 5 filter chips, table with all columns, Nova Fatura dialog, payment dialog, WhatsApp button for invoices with phone, (13) Frontend OrcamentosPage shows stock badge next to Item label when item name matches material description, (14) Sidebar navigation paths without accents all work correctly.
